name: io.github.danielefinocchiaro/unofficial-bambu-mcp
title: Bambu Studio (unofficial)
description: Build, edit, slice, check and calibrate Bambu Studio projects; read a Bambu Lab printer's status.

environmentVariables.name: UBMCP_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where projects, sliced files and print files are saved (default ~/Documents/unofficial-bambu-mcp)

environmentVariables.name: BAMBU_STUDIO_EXE
environmentVariables.description: Path of the Bambu Studio executable, if it is not found automatically

environmentVariables.name: BAMBU_PRINTER_IP
environmentVariables.description: Printer IP address, to skip the search on the local network
